temporary.example_en: The school built a temporary classroom after the storm.
temporary.example_zh: 暴风雨过后，学校搭了一间临时教室。

terrible.example_en: A terrible headache kept me home from the match.
terrible.example_zh: 我头疼得厉害，没能去看那场比赛。

thick.example_en: Mom cut a thick slice of bread for breakfast.
thick.example_zh: 妈妈早餐时切了一片厚面包。

thin.example_en: The ice on the pond looks thin after the rain.
thin.example_zh: 雨后，池塘上的冰看起来很薄。

tight.example_en: These football shoes feel tight around my toes.
tight.example_zh: 这双足球鞋把我的脚趾夹得很紧。

tiny.example_en: A tiny spider sat on the kitchen window frame.
tiny.example_zh: 一只极小的蜘蛛停在厨房的窗框上。

tired.example_en: Dad came home tired after the night shift.
tired.example_zh: 爸爸上完夜班，回到家时已经很累了。

top.example_en: She got the top score on Friday's maths test.
top.example_zh: 她在星期五的数学测验中得了最高分。

total.example_en: The total cost of the picnic food was twenty yuan.
total.example_zh: 野餐的食物总共花了二十元。

tough.example_en: The last science problem was tough for everyone.
tough.example_zh: 最后一道科学题大家都觉得很难。

true.example_en: Is it true that Dad bought tickets for the match?
true.example_zh: 爸爸真的给比赛买了票吗？

Turkish.example_en: We tried a Turkish dish at my uncle's house.
Turkish.example_zh: 我们在叔叔家尝了一道土耳其菜。

typical.example_en: A typical breakfast at our school is rice and eggs.
typical.example_zh: 我们学校典型的早餐是米饭和鸡蛋。

ultimate.example_en: Winning the city cup was our ultimate goal.
ultimate.example_zh: 夺得市杯是我们最终的目标。

unable.example_en: I was unable to finish the exam before the bell.
unable.example_zh: 铃响之前，我没能做完试卷。

universal.example_en: Music is a universal language in our exchange club.
universal.example_zh: 在我们的交流社团里，音乐是一种通用的语言。

unknown.example_en: The caller was unknown, so Mom did not answer.
unknown.example_zh: 打电话来的人不知道是谁，所以妈妈没有接。

unlikely.example_en: Rain looks unlikely, so we will walk to school.
unlikely.example_zh: 看起来不太会下雨，所以我们走路去学校。

unusual.example_en: An unusual bird landed on our balcony this morning.
unusual.example_zh: 今天早上，一只少见的鸟落在我们的阳台上。

upper.example_en: The upper line of the form is for your class number.
upper.example_zh: 表格上面的一行是填班级号的。

used.example_en: I bought a used bike at the weekend market.
used.example_zh: 我在周末市场买了一辆二手自行车。

useful.example_en: A map is useful when we visit a new city.
useful.example_zh: 去一座新城市的时候，地图很有用。

useless.example_en: This broken pen is useless during the exam.
useless.example_zh: 这支坏了的笔考试时派不上用场。

usual.example_en: We took the usual path through the park.
usual.example_zh: 我们走了公园里平常的那条小路。

valid.example_en: Your student card is valid until the end of June.
valid.example_zh: 你的学生卡到六月底都有效。

various.example_en: The shop sells various fruits from nearby farms.
various.example_zh: 这家店出售附近农场的各种水果。

vast.example_en: We climbed the hills and saw a vast lake beyond them.
vast.example_zh: 我们爬上山丘，看见远处有一片很大的湖。

visual.example_en: The visual guide helped me set up the new printer.
visual.example_zh: 这份图解帮我把新打印机装好了。

voluntary.example_en: Joining the library club is voluntary this term.
voluntary.example_zh: 这学期参加图书馆社团是自愿的。

vulnerable.example_en: Young plants are vulnerable in the cold night wind.
vulnerable.example_zh: 幼苗在夜里的寒风中很容易受伤。

warm.example_en: Grandma's kitchen felt warm after the snowy walk.
warm.example_zh: 在雪地里走回来以后，奶奶的厨房很暖和。

weak.example_en: He felt weak and stayed in bed after the flu.
weak.example_zh: 他患流感之后浑身无力，一直躺在床上。

weird.example_en: The soup tasted weird because I added too much salt.
weird.example_zh: 这汤味道奇怪，因为我盐放得太多了。

western.example_en: We watched a western film about cowboys last night.
western.example_zh: 昨晚我们看了一部讲牛仔的西部电影。

wet.example_en: My socks were wet after I walked home in the rain.
wet.example_zh: 我冒雨走回家，袜子全湿了。

white.example_en: She wore a white shirt for the school photo.
white.example_zh: 拍集体照的时候，她穿了一件白衬衫。

whole.example_en: I spent the whole evening helping Dad cook dinner.
whole.example_zh: 我花了整个晚上帮爸爸做晚饭。

wide.example_en: The river is too wide to cross without a bridge.
wide.example_zh: 这条河太宽了，没有桥就过不去。

wild.example_en: We saw wild ducks on the lake behind school.
wild.example_zh: 我们在学校后面的湖上看见了野鸭。

willing.example_en: Tom is willing to share his notes before the test.
willing.example_zh: 汤姆乐意在测验前把自己的笔记分享出来。

wonderful.example_en: We had a wonderful picnic by the river on Saturday.
wonderful.example_zh: 星期六我们在河边野餐，玩得特别开心。

wooden.example_en: The wooden bridge shook when the truck drove over it.
wooden.example_zh: 卡车开过去的时候，那座木桥晃了起来。

worried.example_en: Mom looked worried when my brother came home late.
worried.example_zh: 弟弟很晚才回家，妈妈看起来很担心。

worth.example_en: This old camera is worth more than I expected.
worth.example_zh: 这台旧相机比我预想的更值钱。

written.example_en: Monday afternoon is the deadline for our written report.
written.example_zh: 我们书面报告的截止日期是星期一下午。

wrong.example_en: I took the wrong train and arrived home late.
wrong.example_zh: 我坐错了火车，回家晚了。

yellow.example_en: The yellow leaves covered the path in the park.
yellow.example_zh: 黄叶铺满了公园里的小路。

young.example_en: My young cousin just started primary school this year.
young.example_zh: 我的小表弟今年刚上小学。

whenever.example_en: Whenever it rains, we play cards in the living room.
whenever.example_zh: 一下雨，我们就在客厅里打牌。

absence.example_en: His absence from choir practice worried the music teacher.
absence.example_zh: 他没来参加合唱排练，音乐老师很担心。

abundance.example_en: The garden has an abundance of tomatoes this summer.
abundance.example_zh: 今年夏天，园子里的番茄多得不得了。

abuse.example_en: No one should shout abuse at a player after a match.
abuse.example_zh: 比赛结束以后，谁都不该冲着球员大骂。

academy.example_en: My sister trains every evening at the music academy.
academy.example_zh: 我姐姐每天晚上都在音乐学院训练。

accent.example_en: She put the accent on the wrong syllable and we laughed.
accent.example_zh: 她把重音放错了音节，惹得我们笑了起来。

acceptance.example_en: Her letter of acceptance from the art club arrived yesterday.
acceptance.example_zh: 她昨天收到了美术社团的录取信。

accessory.example_en: This phone case is an accessory I bought at the mall.
accessory.example_zh: 这个手机壳是我在商场买的配件。

accident.example_en: A small accident blocked traffic outside our school.
accident.example_zh: 学校门外出了一起小事故，把路堵住了。

account.example_en: Dad checked his bank account after buying the tickets.
account.example_zh: 爸爸买完票以后查看了银行账户。

accountant.example_en: My aunt works as an accountant in a small office.
accountant.example_zh: 我姑姑在一间小办公室里做会计。

accuracy.example_en: Check the accuracy of your measurements before cutting the wood.
accuracy.example_zh: 锯木头之前，先核对测量是否准确。

ache.example_en: A dull ache in my leg started during the race.
ache.example_zh: 比赛途中，我的腿开始隐隐作痛。

acknowledgment.example_en: She smiled in acknowledgment when the teacher praised her.
acknowledgment.example_zh: 老师表扬她时，她微笑着点头回应。

acquaintance.example_en: I met an old acquaintance outside the football stadium.
acquaintance.example_zh: 我在足球场外面遇见了一位老熟人。

acre.example_en: That farm grows rice on about one acre of land.
acre.example_zh: 那个农场大约用一英亩地种水稻。

action.example_en: Quick action stopped the fire in the school kitchen.
action.example_zh: 迅速行动扑灭了学校厨房里的火。

activity.example_en: Our class activity this weekend was a park clean-up.
activity.example_zh: 这个周末，我们班的活动是打扫公园。

actor.example_en: The actor bowed after the school play ended.
actor.example_zh: 校园剧结束时，男演员鞠了一躬。

actress.example_en: The actress forgot her line and laughed with us.
actress.example_zh: 女演员忘了台词，跟着我们一起笑了。

ad.example_en: I saw an ad for cheap trainers in the shop window.
ad.example_zh: 我在商店橱窗里看到一则便宜运动鞋的广告。

addition.example_en: Addition is easier for me than long division.
addition.example_zh: 对我来说，加法比长除法容易。

addressee.example_en: The addressee's name goes on the front of the envelope.
addressee.example_zh: 收件人的姓名写在信封的正面。

adjective.example_en: We circled every adjective on the weather worksheet.
adjective.example_zh: 我们在天气练习纸上圈出了每一个形容词。

administration.example_en: The school administration moved the exam to Monday.
administration.example_zh: 学校行政部门把考试改到了星期一。

admiration.example_en: We watched in admiration as she finished the marathon.
admiration.example_zh: 她跑完马拉松时，我们都钦佩地看着。

admission.example_en: Admission to the museum is free for students on Sunday.
admission.example_zh: 星期天，学生可以免费进入博物馆。

adverb.example_en: Carefully is an adverb in our lab report sentence.
adverb.example_zh: 在我们实验报告的那个句子里，carefully 是副词。

advert.example_en: The advert for the concert was stuck on the wall.
advert.example_zh: 音乐会的广告贴在墙上。

advertising.example_en: Advertising on the school website brought more visitors.
advertising.example_zh: 学校网站上登的广告带来了更多访问者。

advice.example_en: Mom's advice helped me choose a safer bike route.
advice.example_zh: 妈妈的建议帮我选了一条更安全的骑车路线。

adviser.example_en: Our career adviser suggested a summer job at the library.
adviser.example_zh: 职业顾问建议我暑假到图书馆去打工。

aerobics.example_en: Morning aerobics left my legs shaking before school.
aerobics.example_zh: 早上的健美操让我上学前腿一直在抖。

affair.example_en: The missing wallet became a family affair that evening.
affair.example_zh: 那天晚上，钱包丢了成了全家人的事。

affection.example_en: The puppy showed affection by sleeping on her shoes.
affection.example_zh: 小狗睡在她的鞋子上，显得非常亲热。

African.example_en: An African joined our basketball team last September.
African.example_zh: 去年九月，一位非洲人加入了我们的篮球队。

afternoon.example_en: We played basketball all afternoon behind the gym.
afternoon.example_zh: 我们整个下午都在体育馆后面打篮球。

age.example_en: Children of his age usually ride the school bus.
age.example_zh: 他这个年龄的孩子通常都坐校车。

agency.example_en: The travel agency booked our train tickets yesterday.
agency.example_zh: 旅行社昨天把我们的火车票订好了。

agenda.example_en: Sports day is the first item on the school agenda.
agenda.example_zh: 运动会是学校议程上的第一项。

agent.example_en: The ticket agent found us two seats near the window.
agent.example_zh: 售票员给我们找到了两个靠窗的座位。

agreement.example_en: Both teams signed an agreement before the friendly match.
agreement.example_zh: 两支队伍在友谊赛开始前签了一份协议。

agriculture.example_en: Our village depends on agriculture and the summer rain.
agriculture.example_zh: 我们村靠农业和夏天的雨水过日子。

aid.example_en: The clinic sent aid to families who lost their homes.
aid.example_zh: 诊所向失去房子的家庭送去了救助。

air.example_en: Open a window so fresh air can enter the kitchen.
air.example_zh: 打开一扇窗，让新鲜空气进到厨房里。

aircraft.example_en: A small aircraft flew over the sports field at noon.
aircraft.example_zh: 中午，一架小型飞机从运动场上空飞过。

airline.example_en: Which airline are we taking for the family holiday?
airline.example_zh: 这次全家出去度假，我们坐哪家航空公司？

airplane.example_en: The airplane landed late because of thick fog.
airplane.example_zh: 因为浓雾，飞机晚点降落了。

aisle.example_en: A suitcase blocked the aisle on the crowded train.
aisle.example_zh: 拥挤的火车上，一只行李箱挡住了过道。

album.example_en: Grandma showed us an album of old family photos.
album.example_zh: 奶奶把一本旧的家庭相册拿给我们看。

alcohol.example_en: The nurse cleaned my cut with alcohol at the clinic.
alcohol.example_zh: 护士在诊所里用酒精给我洗了伤口。

Allah.example_en: My friend thanks Allah before every family meal.
Allah.example_zh: 我的朋友每次和家人吃饭前都会感谢安拉。

allowance.example_en: I saved my weekly allowance for a new football.
allowance.example_zh: 我把每周的零花钱攒下来买一个新足球。

alphabet.example_en: The alphabet song helped my little brother learn letters.
alphabet.example_zh: 字母歌帮我弟弟学会了字母。

am.example_en: The train leaves at seven am from the east station.
am.example_zh: 火车上午七点从东站出发。

ambition.example_en: Her ambition is to become a doctor after university.
ambition.example_zh: 她的抱负是大学毕业以后当医生。

ambulance.example_en: An ambulance reached the playground within ten minutes.
ambulance.example_zh: 救护车不到十分钟就赶到了操场。

America.example_en: My cousin studies history in America this year.
America.example_zh: 我表哥今年在美国学习历史。

amusement.example_en: We spent the afternoon at the amusement park.
amusement.example_zh: 我们在游乐园里度过了那个下午。

analysis.example_en: The lab analysis showed sugar in the orange drink.
analysis.example_zh: 实验室的分析显示，这种橙汁饮料里含有糖。

angel.example_en: The little angel in the play wore white wings.
angel.example_zh: 剧里的小天使戴着一对白色的翅膀。

anger.example_en: His anger cooled after he talked with his father.
anger.example_zh: 他和父亲谈过以后，怒气就慢慢消了。

angle.example_en: Draw this angle carefully on your geometry paper.
angle.example_zh: 在几何纸上把这个角仔细画出来。

animal.example_en: A lost animal was sleeping near the school gate.
animal.example_zh: 一只走失的动物睡在学校大门附近。

animation.example_en: The children loved the animation about a brave whale.
animation.example_zh: 孩子们很喜欢那部关于一头勇敢鲸鱼的动画。

ankle.example_en: I twisted my ankle on the stairs at home yesterday.
ankle.example_zh: 昨天我在家里的楼梯上把脚踝扭伤了。

anniversary.example_en: My parents celebrated their anniversary at a quiet restaurant.
anniversary.example_zh: 我父母在一家安静的餐馆庆祝了结婚纪念日。

announcement.example_en: The announcement said the pool would close early.
announcement.example_zh: 公告上说，游泳池会提前关闭。

annoyance.example_en: Traffic noise was a constant annoyance at our flat.
annoyance.example_zh: 车流的噪声一直搅得我们的公寓不得安宁。

answer.example_en: Her answer on the test paper was clear and complete.
answer.example_zh: 她写在试卷上的答案又清楚又完整。

ant.example_en: An ant carried a crumb across the kitchen table.
ant.example_zh: 一只蚂蚁叼着碎屑爬过厨房的桌子。

antique.example_en: That antique clock still rings in my grandfather's house.
antique.example_zh: 那座古董钟在我爷爷家里还会响。

anxiety.example_en: Exam anxiety kept her awake the night before history.
anxiety.example_zh: 历史考试的前一天夜里，她焦虑得睡不着。

apology.example_en: He offered an apology for breaking his sister's cup.
apology.example_zh: 他因为打碎了姐姐的杯子而道了歉。

appearance.example_en: His sudden appearance at the door surprised everyone.
appearance.example_zh: 他突然出现在门口，把大家都吓了一跳。

appetite.example_en: A long hike gave me a huge appetite for noodles.
appetite.example_zh: 走了很长的路以后，我特别想吃面条。

applause.example_en: Loud applause filled the hall after the choir sang.
applause.example_zh: 合唱团唱完以后，大厅里响起了热烈的掌声。

application.example_en: I sent my application to the summer science camp.
application.example_zh: 我把申请书寄给了暑期科学营。

appreciation.example_en: The coach's appreciation made the shy player smile.
appreciation.example_zh: 教练的赏识让那位害羞的队员露出了笑容。

approach.example_en: Our approach to the stadium was slow in the snow.
approach.example_zh: 雪地里，我们走近体育场时速度很慢。

April.example_en: April rain kept the running track muddy for days.
April.example_zh: 四月的雨让跑道一连泥泞了好几天。

apron.example_en: Dad put on an apron before frying the fish.
apron.example_zh: 爸爸煎鱼之前系上了围裙。

architect.example_en: The architect showed us a model of the new hospital.
architect.example_zh: 建筑师给我们看了新医院的模型。

architecture.example_en: Architecture is her chosen major at the city college.
architecture.example_zh: 建筑学是她在市立大学选定的专业。

archive.example_en: Old maps are stored in the city archive downtown.
archive.example_zh: 旧地图存放在市中心的档案馆里。

are.example_en: The rice field behind our house measures one are.
are.example_zh: 我们屋后的那块稻田，面积有一公亩。

arithmetic.example_en: Mental arithmetic helped me check the shop bill.
arithmetic.example_zh: 我用心算核对了商店的账单。

arm.example_en: He raised his arm and waved as his father drove away.
arm.example_zh: 父亲开车离开时，他举起手臂挥手。

armchair.example_en: Grandpa fell asleep in the armchair after lunch.
armchair.example_zh: 午饭后，爷爷在扶手椅上睡着了。

army.example_en: My cousin joined the army after finishing high school.
army.example_zh: 我表哥高中毕业以后参军了。

arrangement.example_en: The alphabetical arrangement made our class list easy to read.
arrangement.example_zh: 名字按字母排列，我们的班级名单就好读了。

arrest.example_en: The arrest of the thief was on the evening news.
arrest.example_zh: 那个小偷被逮捕的消息上了晚间新闻。

arrival.example_en: We waited by the gate for the winner's arrival.
arrival.example_zh: 我们在门口等候获胜者到来。

arrow.example_en: His arrow hit the centre of the target in PE.
arrow.example_zh: 体育课上，他射出的箭正中靶心。

art.example_en: Art club meets in the bright room beside the lab.
art.example_zh: 美术社团在实验室旁边那间明亮的房间活动。

article.example_en: The newspaper article about school lunches made me hungry.
article.example_zh: 报上那篇写学校午餐的文章让我饿了。

artist.example_en: The street artist drew our dog in five minutes.
artist.example_zh: 街头艺术家五分钟就画好了我们的狗。

Asia.example_en: Many of my relatives live in different parts of Asia.
Asia.example_zh: 我的不少亲戚住在亚洲不同的地方。

aspect.example_en: Teamwork is one aspect of a good class project.
aspect.example_zh: 团队合作是做好课堂作业的一个方面。

aspirin.example_en: Mom gave me aspirin when my head hurt badly.
aspirin.example_zh: 我头疼得厉害的时候，妈妈给了我阿司匹林。

assembly.example_en: Morning assembly starts at eight in the main hall.
assembly.example_zh: 晨会八点在大礼堂开始。

assessment.example_en: The science assessment includes a short lab report.
assessment.example_zh: 科学评估包括一份简短的实验报告。

assignment.example_en: This history assignment is due before Friday's class.
assignment.example_zh: 这份历史作业要在星期五上课前交上。

assistance.example_en: I needed assistance to carry the boxes upstairs.
assistance.example_zh: 我需要别人帮忙，才能把那些箱子搬上楼。

association.example_en: The parents' association organised the spring fair.
association.example_zh: 家长协会组织了春季义卖。

astronaut.example_en: The astronaut spoke to our class from the space centre.
astronaut.example_zh: 宇航员从航天中心向我们班讲了话。

astronomer.example_en: The astronomer let us look at the moon through a telescope.
astronomer.example_zh: 天文学家让我们用望远镜观看月亮。

athlete.example_en: The athlete drank water before the final race.
athlete.example_zh: 那位运动员在决赛开始前喝了水。

Atlantic.example_en: Ships cross the Atlantic with food for our city.
Atlantic.example_zh: 轮船载着运给我们城市的食物横渡大西洋。

atmosphere.example_en: Scientists study the atmosphere above the high mountains.
atmosphere.example_zh: 科学家在研究高山上方的大气。

atom.example_en: We cannot see an atom even with the school microscope.
atom.example_zh: 即使用学校的显微镜，我们也看不见原子。

attachment.example_en: I forgot the attachment when I emailed the teacher.
attachment.example_zh: 我给老师发邮件的时候忘了附上附件。

attack.example_en: A bee attack sent the campers running indoors.
attack.example_zh: 蜜蜂突然袭击，露营的人全跑进了屋里。

attendance.example_en: Perfect attendance earned him a prize during assembly.
attendance.example_zh: 他因为全勤，在集会上得了一个奖。

attraction.example_en: The earth's attraction pulled the ball back to the ground.
attraction.example_zh: 地球的引力把球拉回了地面。

audience.example_en: The audience clapped when the dancers left the stage.
audience.example_zh: 舞者走下舞台时，观众鼓起掌来。

August.example_en: We visit my grandparents every August in the countryside.
August.example_zh: 我们每年八月都去乡下看望爷爷奶奶。

aunt.example_en: My aunt brought dumplings when she visited on Sunday.
aunt.example_zh: 姑姑星期天来看我们时，带来了饺子。

aunty.example_en: Aunty lives two stops away and often cooks for us.
aunty.example_zh: 阿姨住在离这儿两站路的地方，经常给我们做饭。

Australia.example_en: My pen friend in Australia sent a photo of kangaroos.
Australia.example_zh: 我在澳大利亚的笔友寄来了一张袋鼠照片。

author.example_en: The author signed my book at the school fair.
author.example_zh: 作者在学校义卖会上给我的书签了名。

autumn.example_en: Leaves turn red in autumn along the river path.
autumn.example_zh: 一到秋天，河边小路上的叶子就变红了。

availability.example_en: Ticket availability is low for the evening concert.
availability.example_zh: 晚场音乐会剩下的票已经很少了。

avenue.example_en: Tall trees shade the avenue near our apartment.
avenue.example_zh: 我们公寓附近的大街被高大的树遮出了阴凉。

award.example_en: She received an award for the best science project.
award.example_zh: 她因为科学项目做得最好而获得了一个奖。

awareness.example_en: The poster raised awareness about saving water at home.
awareness.example_zh: 这张海报让大家更注意在家里节约用水。

baby.example_en: The baby slept through the noisy ride home.
baby.example_zh: 宝宝在嘈杂的回家路上一直睡着。

babysitter.example_en: Our babysitter read stories until my parents came home.
babysitter.example_zh: 保姆一直讲故事，直到我父母回到家。

backache.example_en: Dad's backache started after he moved the sofa.
backache.example_zh: 爸爸把沙发搬完以后，背就开始疼了。

backpacker.example_en: A tired backpacker asked us how to reach the hostel.
backpacker.example_zh: 一位疲惫的背包客问我们青年旅社该怎么走。

backpacking.example_en: Backpacking through the hills left us hungry and happy.
backpacking.example_zh: 在山里背包旅行了一趟，我们又饿又开心。

bacon.example_en: The smell of bacon woke everyone on Saturday morning.
bacon.example_zh: 星期六早上，熏猪肉的香味把大家都叫醒了。

badminton.example_en: We play badminton in the gym when it rains.
badminton.example_zh: 下雨的时候，我们就在体育馆里打羽毛球。

bag.example_en: My bag was heavy with books for the art class.
bag.example_zh: 我的书包里装满了美术课要用的书，沉得很。

baggage.example_en: Our baggage was too heavy for the airport trolley.
baggage.example_zh: 我们的行李太重，机场的手推车都不好推。

baker.example_en: The baker saved us two warm loaves before closing.
baker.example_zh: 面包师关门前给我们留了两条热面包。

balcony.example_en: We ate watermelon on the balcony after dinner.
balcony.example_zh: 晚饭后，我们在阳台上吃西瓜。

ball.example_en: The ball rolled under the sofa during the game.
ball.example_zh: 玩游戏的时候，球滚到了沙发底下。

balloon.example_en: A red balloon escaped and floated over the playground.
balloon.example_zh: 一只红气球飞走了，飘到了操场的上空。

banana.example_en: I packed a banana for the long walk to school.
banana.example_zh: 我为走去学校的那一段长路带了一根香蕉。

band.example_en: The school band practised drums in the music room.
band.example_zh: 学校乐队在音乐教室里练习敲鼓。

bandage.example_en: The nurse put a bandage on my scraped knee.
bandage.example_zh: 护士给我擦伤的膝盖包上了绷带。

bank.example_en: Mom stopped at the bank before picking me up.
bank.example_zh: 妈妈来接我之前，先去了银行一趟。

banking.example_en: Online banking lets Dad pay the school fees at home.
banking.example_zh: 爸爸用网上银行在家里就把学费交了。

bar.example_en: He broke a bar of chocolate and shared it at lunch.
bar.example_zh: 他掰开一条巧克力，午饭时分给大家吃。
